title: GHL connection
subtitle: Connect Academy directly to GoHighLevel (no n8n). Add one connection per sub-account; completing a challenge applies its tag to the contact in the matching account.
notAllowed: Only an administrator can manage the GoHighLevel connection.
loadError: Could not load the GHL connections.
empty: No connections yet — add one below so challenges send tags to GHL.
help: The token identifies a GHL account and the sub-account (location) ID says which account it belongs to. On save the token is verified and the name GHL resolves is kept. Each contact is routed by its location. The tag it receives is the challenge key (for example “bienvenido-1”).
locationHelp: The account the token is verified against.
removeDialogDesc: You are about to delete the connection with “{location}”. Challenges will stop sending tags to that account.
